citations.title: Account Executive (SF) @ Jack & Jill
excerpts: The immediate job is acquisition and customer expansion: get SF-headquartered companies activated on the platform. That means working rooms, running events, doing outbound, talking to founders, and converting relationships into sign-ups. We're looking for an Account Executive to get stuck in on building our mid-market (~50-600 employees) sales motion. Over time this might evolve and change, but this is the key focus for the foreseeable future. You're defining how we enter a market: how we sell, close, and expand. What you learn closing deals feeds back into product and builds the GTM playbook. San Francisco is our most important market and we’re investing heavily into our motion here. We have two people on the ground today, but that’s about to change. You’ll be one of the first hires on the ground and help shape our SF GTM. **What you'll own** Full-cycle selling: prospecting, discovery, close. No BDR, no inbound handoff. You build your own pipeline.
